'''Pepper fettles''' were a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. They could be used to flavor dishes; [[Junobian soft-shell sand flier]]s were flavored by sautéing them in [[Spice/Legends|spices]] and pepper fettles.<ref name="II">{{JournalCite|12|Idol Intentions}}</ref>
